messages:
Alex W: quick check — I pulled a small sandbox of proxy logs and I see full user prompts and what looks like email addresses in the request body. are we actively redacting PII from request/response bodies and headers before they hit long-term logs?
Maria G: which proxy/stack are you looking at? hosted-api or dedicated-proxy?
Alex W: dedicated-proxy in prod-eu. sample looked like: `{"prompt":"Invoice from john.doe@example.com: ...","metadata":{"session_id":"s_123"}}` — the email is in the prompt. also saw `authorization` header logged in one line.
Samir: we intentionally redact `Authorization` and `Cookie` in the ingress filter, but the prompt body is trickier because we only scrub based on patterns right now. emails should be caught by the email regex, but if people paste structured data it can slip.
Maria G: can you paste the exact log line (sanitized)? that helps decide if it's a filter miss or a logging path that bypasses scrubber.
Alex W: pasted sanitized line below (removed model id):
```
INFO 2026-05-14 13:12:06 proxy.request id=abc123 headers={"Authorization":"REDACTED","Content-Type":"application/json"} body={"prompt":"Invoice from john.doe@example.com for $1200
Card 4242-4242-4242-4242"}
```
Samir: ah — card numbers are being masked by cc regex, but the `prompt` field contains both email and CC on one line, looks like our current mask only runs on top-level fields before JSON stringification. when body is kept as a raw string we miss nested tokens.
sec-bot: policy-check: PII redaction policy v2.1 requires masking for emails, phone numbers, and payment card numbers in logs for all environments. Non-compliance should be escalated.
Maria G: thanks. action items: 1) Alex — save the exact raw log and drop in a private bug with sample (sanitized) 2) Samir — confirm whether scrub runs before or after JSON->string conversion in the dedicated-proxy path 3) security team to decide if we need an emergency scrub job for existing short-term logs.
Alex W: filing ticket now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-4321 (sanitized sample attached). tagging for priority.
Samir: I'll investigate scrub order and follow up today. if scrub runs after stringify we can add an extra pass to run regexes on the final string as a stopgap. longer-term we should add structured PII detectors (NER) to avoid regex misses.
ops-bot: deploy noted: dedicated-proxy (prod-eu) last deploy 2026-05-12 22:45 UTC. no config changes since.
Maria G: sounds good. sec team — any objection to a short retention purge (7 days) on the affected log bucket while we triage?
sec-bot: approve-provisional-purge: approved by security on-call for 48 hours. please follow purge SOP and notify legal if any customer data confirmed.
Alex W: thanks — will coordinate purge and update ticket. ping me if you need the raw sample. :thumbsup:
